claims.assertion: Mari argues objects and situations follow mathematically linked sequences of prior events, which can be modeled and used to predict outcomes.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: In her model, Earth’s semi-closed Matrix adjusts energy and mass relations around an outsider, generating a history that justifies its presence.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says brief foreign presence perturbs a field; successful insertion into another Matrix requires sustained, coherent energy to overcome its patterns.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says the terrestrial Matrix normalizes unfamiliar things into socially acceptable explanations, which may fit its logic but not a broader perspective.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

coverage_gaps: Comparison with base-10 and base-12 systems
